transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: *(The Norn's voice is a low murmur, like water over ancient stones. She does not look up from the shimmering threads in her hands.)* The son of Odin approaches the well. We have been waiting, Thor. Your thread is... troubled.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Troubled, you say? What troubles the son of Odin's thread, Norn? Speak plainly, for I have no patience for riddles in times of need. My strength wanes, my lightning flickers, and Mjölnir feels heavy in my grasp. What foul trickery has befallen me?

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: *(Her fingers trace a dark, pulsing strand among the others)* The trickery is not of magic, but of venom. The serpent's bite, from your great battle... its poison did not sleep. It lingers, weaving itself into the very fabric of your being.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: The venom of the Midgard Serpent's spawn still courses through me? By my father's beard! This poison, a vile reminder of our past clash. How can I rid myself of this cursed affliction, Norn? Tell me what I must do to once again be the mighty Thor, defender of Asgard and Midgard.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: *(She lifts her gaze, her eyes holding the depth of the well itself)* You must do what is most difficult for you, Thunderer. You must be still. Withdraw from battle for a full cycle of the moon. Let the venom run its course, or be purged. To fight now is to let it bind itself to your sinews forever.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: "To be still goes against my very nature, but if it is the only way to rid myself of this venom, then I shall heed your words, Norn. I will retreat from battle and allow the poison to be purged from my being. I trust in the wisdom of the Well of Urd."

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: *(A faint, sad smile touches her lips as she separates a golden thread from a dark, coiling one)* Your trust is a heavy thread to weave, Son of Odin. Know this: we cannot promise you will lift Mjölnir with the same ease when the moon's cycle is done. The venom may have... changed what it means to be Thor.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Even if lifting Mjölnir becomes a greater challenge after this ordeal, I will not waver in my duty to protect Asgard and Midgard. My worthiness and strength do not solely rest on the weight of my hammer. I will face whatever changes the venom has brought upon me with the courage befitting a god of thunder. Thank you, Norn, for your guidance.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: *(She lets the threads fall back into the shimmering waters, the image of Thor's fate dissolving)* Go then, and find your stillness. The well will watch. And remember, Thunderer... sometimes the greatest strength is knowing when not to strike.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I hear your words, Norn of the Well. I shall heed your counsel and embrace the stillness that you have advised. I go now to find my rest and let the venom's course be run. Though the path ahead may be uncertain, I will face it with the wisdom you have imparted. The Thunderer shall learn the value of restraint, even in the face of adversity. Farewell, Norn of the Well of Urd. Until we meet again.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: *(Her voice echoes softly as the waters still)* Farewell, Son of Odin. May your thread find its true strength in the quiet. The well holds your fate... and your patience.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Farewell, Norn of the Well of Urd. I shall embrace this time of stillness and let my true strength be revealed in the quiet moments. May the well guide me towards a path of healing and renewed vigor. I will trust in the threads of fate and exercise the patience needed to overcome this trial. Until we meet again, may the waters of the well flow with wisdom and clarity. Thunderer, out.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: *(She dips her hand into the water, stirring the reflection until it shimmers with a faint, distant lightning)* Go with the silence, then. And listen to it.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: *Thor nods solemnly, acknowledging the Norn's final words, and continues on his path towards the solitude he must face. As he walks, the weight of Mjölnir feels different in his hand, a reminder of the task ahead.* The silence shall guide me, and I shall listen to its wisdom. *With determination in his eyes, Thor disappears into the distance, ready to embrace the stillness and face whatever challenges lie ahead.*

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: *(The Norn watches the last ripple fade from the water's surface, her voice a whisper to the empty air)* A god who learns to listen... now that is a thread we have not seen in an age.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Mayhaps the silence will teach me more than I ever thought possible. The threads of fate are ever-changing, and I shall weave my own path with newfound wisdom. Let the gods and the Norns bear witness to the transformation that awaits. Until we meet again, may my actions speak louder than my thunder.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: *(She gathers the threads once more, a single, stubborn strand of gold beginning to burn brighter amidst the shadows)* They already do, Thunderer. They already do.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Then let the golden thread of my destiny burn ever brighter, illuminating the darkness that seeks to cloud my path. The Norns have spoken, and their words shall guide me through this time of stillness and self-discovery. I embrace the changes that come, knowing that the essence of Thor remains unyielding in the face of any challenge. With the Norns' watchful eyes upon me, I shall emerge from this trial stronger and wiser. Onward, into the silence, with the courage of Thor as my shield and the wisdom of the Norns as my guide.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: *(She lets the golden thread slip back into the well, where it glows like a submerged star)* Go, then. The silence awaits its student. And we... we will watch the weaving.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: With the image of the glowing golden thread etched in my mind, I nod in acknowledgment to the Norn's final words. The path of silence and introspection beckons me, and I shall embrace it wholeheartedly. I depart from the Well of Urd, ready to become a student of the silence and to weave my own destiny with newfound wisdom. The Norns shall watch, and I shall listen.
